shots.storyline: Indoor badminton hall with a blue court, green surrounds, a net across mid-frame, and YONEX / 旭日星空 banners overhead; a 李宇轩教练 + bilibili watermark sits top-right. The clip opens with the shuttle already in flight, descending from high above the net toward S01-P01's screen-right side (0.0–0.9); S01-P02's raised right arm at 0.0–0.2 is the follow-through of a delivery whose release occurred before the shot start. S01-P01, from a wide ready stance, steps out to his forehand side and loads into a reach (0.5–0.9), meeting the low shuttle around 0.9–1.0 with a right-handed sideways-to-upward swing; the shuttle rises high above the net center at 1.1 and leaves view. P01 recovers to a balanced ready stance by 1.5–1.7 while P02 resets and briefly gestures with his right hand (1.8–1.9, no shuttle release). Around 2.0–2.2 P02 raises his bare right hand overhead and releases the shuttle, which arcs high (2.1–2.3) and descends toward P01's screen-right side (2.4–2.9). P01 again lunges forehand-side, contacts low near 2.9–3.0, and the shuttle climbs above the net to screen-right (3.1–3.3) before beginning to descend (3.4–3.8); the clip ends with that shuttle still in flight and P01 returning upright. No speech or sounds are available to this stage.

Both players hold position until ~5.7 s, when S02-P01 again raises the shuttle in his right hand and releases it (~6.0 s); the second feed descends to the same forecourt area (6.1-6.5 s). The clip ends with S02-P01 still standing with racket lowered at his left side and S02-P02 in a crouched ready position; no racket stroke by S02-P01 is visible in this shot, his deliveries are bare-hand tosses.
